```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
final_raw <- read_csv("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/AI_assisted_litreview/Screening2_AI/Final.csv")
```

```{r}
final_abbrev <- final_raw %>%
  select(ID=`original ID`, First_Author = `First author`, Year = year,
         Journal_Abrev = `Journal Abbreviation` , Title, Tags, Summary = `AI Summary`)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

final_cleaned1 <- final_abbrev %>%
  # 1. Create a row ID to keep track of individual papers during the pivot
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  
  # 2. Duplicate Tags so we don't destroy the original column
  mutate(temp_tag = Tags) %>%
  
  # 3. Split the comma-separated strings into multiple rows (one tag per row)
  separate_longer_delim(temp_tag, delim = ",") %>%
  mutate(temp_tag = str_trim(temp_tag)) %>% # Clean up trailing/leading spaces
    distinct()%>%
  # 4. Classify the tags and strip out the prefixes
  mutate(
    tag_type = case_when(
      str_detect(temp_tag, "^SecondPassAI-(Include|Exclude|EdgeCase-Include|EdgeCase-Exclude)$") ~ "Decision",
      str_detect(temp_tag, "^SecondPassAI-ExcludeReason-") ~ "Reason",
      TRUE ~ "Other" # Catches things like "Prompt Gen" or "Screen1"
    ),
    clean_value = case_when(
      temp_tag == "SecondPassAI-Include" ~ "include",
      temp_tag == "SecondPassAI-Exclude" ~ "exclude",
      temp_tag == "SecondPassAI-EdgeCase-Include" ~ "edge_include",
      temp_tag == "SecondPassAI-EdgeCase-Exclude" ~ "edge_exclude",
      tag_type == "Reason" ~ str_remove(temp_tag, "^SecondPassAI-ExcludeReason-"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # 5. Drop the "Other" tags (we only want to pivot Decisions and Reasons into new columns)
  filter(!is.na(clean_value)) %>%
  
  # 6. Group by paper and tag type to dynamically number the reasons (Reason1, Reason2...)
  group_by(row_id, tag_type) %>%
  mutate(
    col_name = if_else(tag_type == "Reason", paste0("Reason", row_number()), tag_type)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # 7. Keep only what we need to pivot
  select(row_id, col_name, clean_value) %>%
  
  # 8. Pivot back to wide format. R will automatically figure out how many Reason columns it needs!
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_name,
    values_from = clean_value
  ) %>%
  
  # 9. Join back to the original dataframe so papers with NO decisions/reasons aren't lost
  right_join(
    final_abbrev %>% mutate(row_id = row_number()), 
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  
  # 10. Clean up the row_id and reorder the columns nicely
  select(-row_id) %>%
  relocate(Tags, Decision, starts_with("Reason"))
```

```{r}
final<- final_cleaned1 %>%
  select(ID, First_Author, Year, Journal_Abrev, Title, Decision, Reason1, Reason2, Reason3, Summary)
```

```{r}
table(final$Decision)
```

```{r}
table(final$Decision, final$Reason1)
```

```{r}
view_summary_func <- function(title_str){
  df <- final %>%
    filter(grepl(title_str, Title))%>%
    select(Title, Summary)
  
  print(df$Title)
  print(df$Summary)
}
```

